name: BROMHEXINE 80MG/100ML INFANT SOLUTION 1 PIECE
description: Bromhexine solution for children 80mg/100ml is a mucolytic medication indicated for children, which helps to thin and facilitate the expulsion of bronchial secretions. It is an adjunct treatment in respiratory illnesses, both chronic and acute, associated with abnormal mucus production. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
